summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Sladkiygramm 3.6 Expo React Native messenger app. All core features tested and working correctly. New user registration, chat functionality, theme switching, language switching, profile editing, and navigation all functional.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: useNativeDriver not supported (expected), props.pointerEvents deprecated, textShadow* deprecated
Element references lost after language switch - requires re-querying selectors

critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is excellent with proper testID attributes on all interactive elements
React Native components properly used (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, TextInput)
Firebase integration working correctly with real-time data sync
Theme system well implemented with 4 themes and auto-theme support
i18n properly implemented for EN/RU languages
Mobile-first design with proper touch targets (44x44 minimum)
Package version warnings present but not causing functional issues

success_rate.backend: N/A - Frontend only app with Firebase

seed_data_creation: Created test users: TestBotm3n4ox, TestFABuynwjh with messages in Favorites chat
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a Firebase-only app with no backend API. All features tested and working. Element references may need re-querying after language changes. Package version warnings are non-blocking.
